name: Potolok
source:
A boy is trapped in a room with no doors or windows. He has clearly been there for a long time. Perhaps you should talk to him about what’s bothering you.

[From [url=https://chifu333.itch.io/the-celling]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩被困在一个没有门窗的房间里。他显然已经在那里呆了很长时间了。也许你应该和他谈谈困扰你的事情。

[来自[url=https://chifu333.itch.io/the-celling]Itch.io[/url]]
